$comment: Catalogue entries this pipeline provides, to be ingested into the Agora catalogue. Run details (retrieval date, checksum) are in the outputs' .meta.json files.

key.name: ine_code
key.description: INE municipality code: five digits, the province's two followed by three of the municipality's (without INE's control digit).

entity_types.description: Land held in common by several municipalities (comunidades, facerías, parzonerías, ledanías, Bardenas Reales…). Not a municipality: it has no INE code and no population of its own.

key.name: ign_code
key.description: IGN national code: 34 + CCAA + province + 53 + three digits.

relation_types.description: The municipality belongs to the province.
The province IGN files the shared territory under; a few extend into a neighbouring province.

description.es: Límites de los 8.132 municipios vigentes, con su código INE (cinco dígitos) y su nombre oficial, bilingüe donde lo es. Es la geometría para cartografiar cualquier dato municipal: une por ine_code o por id.
description.en: Boundaries of the 8,132 current municipalities, with their INE code (five digits) and official name, bilingual where official. It's the geometry to map any municipal data: join by ine_code or id.

processing.es: Del servicio WFS INSPIRE de unidades administrativas del IGN, en WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Solo los municipios actuales; los territorios compartidos entre municipios van aparte.
processing.en: From IGN's INSPIRE administrative units WFS, in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Current municipalities only; territories shared between municipalities are a dataset of their own.

datasets.title: Municipios de España (IGN, unidades administrativas INSPIRE)

source.filter: nationalLevel = 4thOrder, units whose code carries an INE municipality code

description.es: El servicio publica los municipios y límites actuales, sin fechas de vigencia: los datos son válidos a la fecha de su descarga. No incluye los municipios que ya no existen; su historia vendrá del registro del INE.
description.en: The service publishes the current municipalities and boundaries, without validity dates; the data is valid as of its retrieval date. Municipalities that no longer exist are not included; their history will come from INE's registry.

excluded.name: Territorios no asociados a ninguna provincia
excluded.reason: Plazas de soberanía, Isla de los Faisanes and Gibraltar: not INE municipalities.

excluded.name: Shared territories
excluded.reason: Not municipalities; published as the ign_au_shared_territories dataset.

geometry.resolution: full (as published by IGN, not simplified)

description.es: Id del municipio en el catálogo (es:ine:mun:{ine_code}).
Código INE del municipio (cinco dígitos, sin dígito de control).
description.en: INE municipality code (five digits, no control digit).

description.es: Nombre oficial tal como lo publica el IGN; bilingüe donde lo es.
description.en: Official name as published by IGN; bilingual where official.

description.es: Código INE de la comunidad autónoma.
Id de la provincia en el catálogo (es:ine:prov:{province_code}).
Código nacional del IGN (34 + comunidad + provincia + código INE).
description.en: IGN national code (34 + CCAA + province + INE code).

datasets.update_frequency: yearly or on demand (municipalities are created, merged and renamed a few times a year)

description.es: Territorios que pertenecen a varios municipios a la vez (facerías, comunidades de pastos o montes de aprovechamiento común), que no forman parte de ningún término municipal. Son 81 y completan el mapa municipal.
description.en: Territories belonging to several municipalities at once (joint pastures or commons), outside any single municipality. There are 81 and they complete the municipal map.

processing.es: Del servicio WFS INSPIRE de unidades administrativas del IGN, en WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
processing.en: From IGN's INSPIRE administrative units WFS, in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

datasets.title: Territorios compartidos entre municipios (IGN, unidades administrativas INSPIRE)

source.filter: nationalLevel = 4thOrder, units whose code carries 53 instead of the province

description.es: Estado actual tal como lo publica el IGN; válido a la fecha de su descarga.
description.en: Current state as published by IGN; valid as of its retrieval date.

geometry.resolution: full (as published by IGN, not simplified)

description.es: Nombre tal como lo publica el IGN; algunos enumeran los códigos INE de los municipios que lo comparten.
description.en: Name as published by IGN; some list the INE codes of the municipalities that share it.

description.es: Código INE de la provincia en la que lo incluye el IGN.
description.en: INE code of the province IGN files it under.

description.es: Código INE de la comunidad autónoma.
Id de esa provincia en el catálogo.
